name: Shirogane Otome
source:
On a small hill located on the outskirts of Ibushi-chou stands the Shirogane Shrine. It is owned by the Hisakawa family, who take care of two girls… or rather, one girl and one trap. Yuki is a boyish maiden who is very popular among the students at Akishino Central School. Tsubasa is cute enough to be granted entrance to the girl’s school as an exception. They have been together since they were kids, so one can never find one without the other. Despite their genders, they sleep in the same room and play together. Even though Tsubasa viewed Yuki as being more than a friend, he would not let their relationship go beyond that.

One day, while they were walking home, they came upon a starving miko Sarasa. She told them she was an exorcist who was chasing after a powerful apparition called the ‘maou’. Since there was a high possibility that the maou would infiltrate the school, she temporarily stayed at the shrine with them. She had Yuki’s full support since she wanted a change from everyday boring life. When Sarasa found out that there were students (including Yuki’s friends) who were possessed by other powerful apparitions at the school, she asked for Yuki’s help. Yuki gladly obliged since she loves bishoujos, and she even has a special ability which no one knows about.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
白银神社坐落在月伏镇郊外的一座小山丘上。它由久川家管理，照顾着两个女孩……或者更准确地说，一个女孩和一个伪娘。雪是一个男孩子气的少女，在秋之宫中央学校的学生中非常受欢迎。翼可爱到被破例允许进入女子学校。她们从小一起长大，形影不离。尽管性别不同，她们睡在同一间房里，一起玩耍。尽管翼将雪视为超越朋友的存在，但他不愿让她们的关系更进一步。

某天，在回家的路上，她们遇到了一个饥饿的巫女更纱。她告诉她们自己是一个正在追捕名为“魔王”的强大灵异存在的驱魔师。由于魔王很有可能潜入学校，她暂时和她们一起住在神社里。雪全力支持她，因为她想要摆脱日常的无聊生活。当更纱发现学校里有学生（包括雪的朋友）被其他强大的灵异存在附身时，她请求雪的帮助。雪欣然答应，因为她喜欢美少女，而且她还拥有一个谁都不知道的特殊能力。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
